component.name: EVE Traveling Merchant
component.summary: Location-centric arbitrage engine and multi-item route planner for EVE Online

description.p: EVE Traveling Merchant is a high-performance market analysis and corridor route planner for EVE Online. Built in native Rust, it connects directly to CCP Games' official EVE Swagger Interface (ESI) API to identify lucrative cross-station trading arbitrage opportunities from your starting solar system.

ul.li: Location-centric scanning: Scans your home system plus stargate-connected neighbor regions.
Multi-item cargo consolidation (Knapsack): Packs multiple high-margin commodities along identical corridors to maximize cargo hold and wallet budget.
Profit-per-jump ranking: Travel jumps to the pickup station and destination station are calculated via Dijkstra pathfinding.
Safe highsec routing: Strictly routes around lowsec and nullsec systems by default.
Multi-stop sequential route planner: Greedily chains profitable legs into multi-hop trading circuits.
Station access pool filter: Toggle between NPC stations (100% public docking) and Upwell Citadels.
Real-time solar system search with autocomplete and security status lookup.
Audible sound alerts when exceptional (100%+ ROI) arbitrage deals are discovered.

description.p: This application is a read-only analysis aid. It does not automate any in-game actions and fully complies with the CCP Games EULA and Developer License Agreement.
